caption: Document structure directly affects how cleanly an exported file reads. JobRez measures six layout rules on the rendered page after every edit, covering single-column order, standard headings, real bullet lists, selectable text, the absence of tables or floats, and a body text size of at least 9.5pt. This structural check is noted as not a certification against any ATS vendor. Maintain your master resume at jobrez.com.
